Football-Data 官方 notes.txt（https://www.football-data.co.uk/notes.txt）明文：
> "These are for pre-closing odds. For the closing odds, as below but with an additional \"C\" character following the bookmaker abbreviation (e.g. B365CH = closing Bet365 home win odds)."
